scope: Polite/negative imperative coverage and literal corruption
findings: dinlemeyiniz changes to dinlemeğiniz at center touches.
Negative polite forms dinlemeyiniz/beklemeyiniz/unutmayınız/dokunmayınız/söylemeyiniz/okumayınız are rejected by production and explicit verb-root morphology, at the n in the imperative sequence.
Short dinlemeyin is rejected by morphology but flat vocabulary protects it.
Replacement dinlemeğiniz is accepted by production and explicit dinle verb-root morphology; full suffix analysis not enumerated.
dinleyin/dinleyiniz accepted by morphology through some path; that does not prove a complete imperative paradigm exists.
classification: Missing negative imperative continuation with a concrete wrong correction; exact accepted competitor derivation pending.
limits: Most of the initial 56 surfaces remained unchanged; no general claim all imperatives are unusable.
next_step: Inspect imperative continuations and accepted competing suffix analysis; extend to first-person optative forms.
